facts.fact: BCEAO Instruction No. 001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024 governs payment services in UMOA, and from 1 September 2025 only licensed entities may provide them, per Agence Ecofin via Digital Mag.
The instruction licenses fintechs with capital of 10 to 100 million FCFA, and one provider was licensed in Burkina Faso by 27 May 2025.
